mapper.select: select gr.course_id as courseId, round(max(gr.total_score) / 100, 4) as score from aem_grade_record gr where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.status = '0' and gr.total_score is not null and gr.course_id is not null group by gr.course_id

select gr.course_id as courseId, round(avg(gr.total_score) / 100, 4) as score from aem_grade_record gr where gr.status = '0' and gr.total_score is not null and gr.course_id is not null and gr.semester_id = #{semesterId} group by gr.course_id
select course_id as courseId, course_name as courseName from tpm_course_library where del_flag = '0'
